text:
I came from the U.S. to get another opinion on what my dentist and periodontist were telling me i needed to get done out there, and I’m soooo happy I paid for the flight, sat in the Grab ride, and made my way to Tooth Boutique.

Not going into the details, but long story short, the team at Tooth Boutique confirmed, with visual evidence and a clear explanation in English, that I didn’t actually need all the things my American dental team were recommending. It saved me a boatload of money and my teeth!

Every person I interacted with at Tooth Boutique was friendly and professional, the space was modern, but more importantly, very very clean, the equipment they used was state-of-the-art - comparable or even better than what you’d find in the U.S, and the service was top-notch (all the cleanings I’ve had previously were less comfortable and less thorough than what I received here).

I don’t hate going to the dentist anymore, and coming from the U.S., I have another reason to visit Thailand more often now.
